mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals a deteriorating labor market, increasing recession risk and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate robust consumer demand and labor market strength, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS increase by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 215), the market prices in the expectation of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 215, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 650 thousand units signal weak residential demand, indicating economic slowdown and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 650, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) indicate stagflation risk, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL is rising and UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions, increasing recession probability and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5% and PAYEMS is declining, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
